suttas.title: Pucchāniddesa
rows: Kodha santusito loketi ko loke tuṭṭho santuṭṭho attamano paripuṇṇasaṅkappoti—
ko’dha santusito loke’ti: ko loke tuṭṭho santuṭṭho attamano paripuṇṇasaṃkappoti
Kodha santusito loketi ko loke tuṭṭho santuṭṭho attamano paripuṇṇasaṅkappoti –
kodha santusito loketi santuṭṭho attamano paripuṇṇasaṅkappoti
Kodha santusito loke ti ko loke tuṭṭho santuṭṭho attamano paripuṇṇasaṅkappoti—
Iccāti padasandhi padasaṁsaggo padapāripūrī akkharasamavāyo byañjanasiliṭṭhatā padānupubbatāpetaṁ—
‘iccā’ti padasandhi padasaṃsaggo padapāripūri akkharasamavāyo byañjanasiliṭṭhatā padānupubbatā. nāmetaṃ
Iccāti padasandhi padasaṃsaggo padapāripūrī akkharasamavāyo byañjanasiliṭṭhatā padānupubbatāpetaṃ –
iccāti padasandhi padasaṃsaggo padapāripūri akkharasamavāyo byañjanasiliṭṭhatā padānupubbakametaṃ
